params.body:
Brings `docs/content-architectuur.md` in line with the choices made for the blog on 2026-10-23, so phase 2 is built from the right plan. A new section §0b lists them; the places that said otherwise are updated.

- **Blog, *Nieuws* in the menu.** The Studio calls it Blog (hoet-sanity #13), addresses are `/{lang}/blog/{slug}` (preview, feed and newsletter feed follow), and the menu item in the main navigation and the footer reads *Nieuws*. Type and class names stay.
- **No author.** The `author` type is gone from the model, the Studio structure, the mirror and the phase checklists; in JSON-LD the author is the brand as `Organization`.
- **Links one way.** Linked frames show as cards under the article and as `about` in JSON-LD. The frame page no longer gets an *In het journal* section (removed from phase 3).
- **Home.** A strip with the three newest articles above the production film, added to phase 2.

Documentation only.
params.title: Record the blog decisions in the content architecture
